dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth as an RFC 3339 full-date (yyyy-MM-dd, zero-padded); a time component is rejected

gender.description: Gender; free string validated against the shared reference list at the caller layer

orgId.description: Organisation id this user belongs to (org catalogue reference)

departmentName.description: Department the user belongs to, e.g. Horticulture, Soil Science, Plant Pathology

entityType.description: User category; free string validated against the shared reference list at the caller layer

password.description: Hashed password (hashed by the portal backend before submission; source of truth)

pin.description: Hashed PIN (hashed by the portal backend before submission; source of truth)

passwordExpiresOn.description: RFC 3339 date-time the password expires; UTC offset is mandatory (e.g. 2026-08-19T10:15:30Z)

pinExpiresOn.description: RFC 3339 date-time the PIN expires; UTC offset is mandatory (e.g. 2026-08-19T10:15:30Z)

region.description: ADDED (from Add User UI 'Coverage Selection'). Region the user's coverage area belongs to -- top level of the Ethiopia location hierarchy (Region > Zone > Woreda > Kebele). ASSUMPTION: stored as the selected region name/value from the Location Hierarchy master; switch to a regionId catalogue reference if that master exposes ids.

zone.description: ADDED (from Add User UI 'Coverage Selection'). Zone within the selected region, second level of the location hierarchy. Depends on region.

woreda.description: ADDED (from Add User UI 'Coverage Selection'). Woreda within the selected zone, third level of the location hierarchy. Depends on zone.

kebele.description: ADDED (from Add User UI 'Coverage Selection'). Kebele within the selected woreda, most granular level of the location hierarchy. Depends on woreda.

createdBy.description: User id of the creator (set by the portal/auth layer)

updatedBy.description: User id of the last updater (set by the portal/auth layer)

catalogueId.description: Reference to the catalogue this functional role is granted on (catalogue catalogue reference, e.g. cat-001).

functionalRoleId.description: Fixed functional role for this catalogue. ASSUMPTION: enum values taken literally from the sample payload provided (maker/checker1/checker2). If this is meant to line up with the canonical MAKER/APPROVAL_L1/APPROVAL_L2 codes used elsewhere in this project's functionalRoleAssignment entity, confirm whether these should be the same three values under different casing/naming, or are genuinely a separate, simpler enum scoped only to this embedded registry array.

displayName.description: Optional display label for this specific catalogue/role grant (e.g. 'FIELD_OFFICER'). Nullable -- sample payload shows null for checker1/checker2 entries, only the maker entry has a value.

registry.description: ADDED. List of catalogue/functional-role grants for this user, embedded directly on the user record (one entry per catalogue the user has a functional role on). A user may hold roles on multiple catalogues at once, e.g. maker on one catalogue and checker1/checker2 on others.
